title: Android IDE Local Project Paths
description: Local machine paths for this project. This file is not a VS Code settings file and must not be committed.

sdkPath.description: Android SDK directory. Relative paths resolve from the project root. Empty uses automatic discovery.

scrcpyPath.description: Optional native scrcpy client executable path. Relative paths resolve from the project root. Empty uses PATH discovery.

downloadDirectory.description: Local download directory. Empty uses the system Downloads directory.

adbPath.description: Optional adb executable path. Empty uses automatic discovery.

ndkPath.description: Optional Android NDK directory. Empty selects an installed or extension-managed NDK.

symbolSearchPaths.description: Optional directories containing unstripped native .so symbols.
